module: Determines whether an observer (the player camera or a vehicle) can "see" a target vehicle. The range depends on the angle: maximum range (80 m) straight ahead, minimum range (5 m) outside the peripheral cone (90°), interpolated between the two. An optional ray checks for the absence of obstacles.
notes: Default parameters: maxDistDirectSight 80 (m), minDistPeriphSight 5 (m), periphSightAngle 90 (degrees), needDirectVisualContact true.
If `params` is provided, only the keys present are read; missing keys fall back to the default values.
The visibility test casts castRay between the two positions raised by 1 m; any obstacle found (static or dynamic) blocks the view.
Two coincident positions (distance < 1e-6) return true with no further test.

checkSighting.desc: Generic visibility test from positions: distance, angle relative to the viewing direction, then occlusion ray.

returns.desc: true if the target is visible.

canPlayerSeeVehicle.desc: Tests whether the player camera sees the target vehicle (position and direction from core_camera).

returns.desc: false if core_camera or the vehicle does not exist.

canVehicleSeeVehicle.desc: Tests whether a vehicle sees another vehicle (observer's position and forward direction).

returns.desc: false if either vehicle does not exist.
